description: Scored crypto briefs from public chain state read through Pocket Network's own RPC endpoints, the Pocket chain and CFTC data: USDT and USDC supply by chain, crypto liquidity, CME bitcoin and ether futures positioning, on-chain ETH and BTC prices, Ethereum and L2 fees, Pocket Network health and staking. Plus address checks and unit conversion. Each brief is a 0-100 score with label, trend, drivers, risk flags, confidence and a citation for every input. Not investment advice. POST /v1/brief with a small JSON body for one scored, cited brief; POST /v1/overview for all of them at once. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Body for POST /v1/brief (other routes take similar small bodies).

outputSchema.description: {service, vertical, title, status, score (0-100), label, trend, trend_basis, summary, drivers[], risk_flags[], confidence{score,label}, coverage, inputs[], watch[], citations[{url}], method}. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).

responseSummary.note: Fill from a live MainNet capture.
